title: Mall World IRL - Hudson Yards
content: I went to New York for the first time last year around Christmas and was wondering if anyone here has been to Hudson Yards… I had the strangest feeling there the entire time, even when I was walking over a bridge in Chelsea to get there. The expensive high rises around it didn’t look real and the people inside of them had NPC vibes. Then the mall itself just did not feel real, none of the stores inside were typical chain stores and all were just so unique. I felt like I was in a mall world dream and it was a really intense experience, the energy was so powerful. Curious if anyones been there or had a similar sensation elsewhere.
